title: Roanoke Cobblemon
description: The oldest NOP2W Cobblemon Network with Gyms, Tournaments, Quests, and more!
body:
# Roanoke Network - NO P2W Cobblemon Server

Roanoke is the oldest NOP2W Cobblemon Server - we've been running the mod since Version 1.0 and have a great community of friendly players & competitive battlers. We have brand new Alolan Style Player Gyms, weekly Tournaments (sometimes with cash prizes!), and a whole bunch of Quests to battle Team Rocket and earn Legendary Pokemon.

# No Pay to Win

![Hat Cosmetics on Roanoke Cobblemon Server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/746fd799ec44267c72d0792c91880fe510b158f2_0.webp)

Our store and ethos is entirely **no pay-to-win**, we don't sell crates, Pokemon, etc - all our store packages are cosmetic / global rewards.

# Good Community

![Pride Bridge & Ho-Oh on Roanoke Cobblemon Server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c78412968b3993c9a671775f49216f8a988b762e_0.webp)

Last Pride Month, **we raised $1,200 dollars** for an LGBT support charity that benefits people and communities across the world.
